extra_quotes: We prepare hBN-encapsulated MoSe 2/Fe3GaTe2 heterostructures by mechanical exfoliation followed by deterministic transfer [33, 34] (see Methods)
We then measure the magneto-optical response of the MoSe2/Fe3GaTe2 heterostructure with a custom-built MOKE spectroscopy setup at 40 K (see Methods).
To quantify the Kerr resonances, we fit ∆θ K with Eq. (1) phenomenologically using N = 4, corresponding to the resonances X 1s A , X 2s A , X 1s B , and X 2s B .

We do not resolve a trion feature in the Kerr spectra: a trion component with free position, amplitude and width is not determined at both field polarities, and the excitation range below 1.61 eV is too sparsely sampled to constrain one.
